# The riva packages

One entry per package: what it is, its entry points, its peers and the docs its tarball ships. Read the pages in `node_modules`, they match the installed version.

## @softistx/riva

Core: signals, Riva, query and mutation engine, normalized and keyed cache, pagination, optimistic layer, dehydrate and hydrate. Pure TypeScript, no DOM, no React.

- Entry points: `@softistx/riva`, `@softistx/riva/entities`, `@softistx/riva/infinite`, `@softistx/riva/ssr`, `@softistx/riva/store`, `@softistx/riva/resource`, `@softistx/riva/data`, `@softistx/riva/rxjs`

## @softistx/riva-react-router

React Router host for riva: one Riva per request with an ambient scope, SSR dehydrate and hydrate through loader data, and a merge on each navigation.

- Entry points: `@softistx/riva-react-router`, `@softistx/riva-react-router/server`
- Peers: `@softistx/riva` `^0.12.0`, `@softistx/riva-react` `^0.12.0`, `react` `^19.0.0`, `react-router` `^8.0.0`, `@softistx/alxia-react-router` `^0.83.1 || ^0.84.0 || ^0.85.0 || ^0.86.0` (optional)

## @softistx/riva-rest

REST transport for riva, typed by OpenAPI through openapi-httpyz, with a free fetcher for schema-less APIs.
